---
title: "Quality of Life SOPS"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| output: false
library(fs)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(rmsb)
library(Hmisc)
library(data.table)
library(future.callr)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_path <- here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "imp-data")
m <- length(dir_ls(data_path))
```

## Functions

```{r}
write_SOP <- function(i, tx, baseline_df, model, path, imp_num){

  row <- baseline_df[i]

  sops <-
  soprobMarkovOrdm(
    model,
    data = list(tx = tx, yprev = row$yprev, gap = row$gap, ecog_fstcnt = row$ecog_fstcnt, diagnosis = row$diagnosis),
    times = 1:26,
    ylevels = 1:7,
    absorb = NULL,
    tvarname = "week",
    pvarname = "yprev"
  )

  # Because of the size of the data, only use the first 2000 MCMC draws
  sops <- sops[1:2000, , ]

  sops <- as.data.table(sops)

  # Rename columns
  setnames(sops,
           old = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "value"),
           new = c("draw", "time", "state", "sop"))

  sops$time <- as.integer(sops$time)
  sops$state <- as.factor(sops$state)
  sops$tx <- tx
  sops$i <- i

  folder <- file.path(path, glue::glue("imp_{imp_num}"), glue::glue("marginalized_sop_{tx}"), glue::glue("msop_{i}.parquet"))

  # Create the directory if it doesn't exist
  dir_to_create <- dirname(folder)
  if (!dir.exists(dir_to_create)) {
    dir.create(dir_to_create, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  arrow::write_parquet(
    x = sops,
    sink = folder
    )
}
```

#### Generate marginalized SOPs

```{r}
output_dir <- here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "results", "sops")
generate_SOPS <- TRUE
future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = 6)

# Get all imputed datasets
imp_files <- dir_ls(data_path)

# Loop over each imputed dataset
for (imp_idx in seq_along(imp_files)) {

  message(glue::glue("Processing imputation {imp_idx} of {m}"))

  # Extract baseline data
  baseline_df <- read_parquet(imp_files[imp_idx]) |>
    group_by(id) |>
    arrange(week) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      week = 1,
      gap = 1,
      y = NA
    ) |>
    select(-week_nl1, -week_nl2) |>
    as.data.table()

  n_patients <- nrow(baseline_df)

  # Check if SOPs already exist for this imputation
  control_dir <- file.path(output_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_0")
  treatment_dir <- file.path(output_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_1")

  control_exists <- dir.exists(control_dir) && length(dir_ls(control_dir)) == n_patients
  treatment_exists <- dir.exists(treatment_dir) && length(dir_ls(treatment_dir)) == n_patients

  if (control_exists && treatment_exists) {
    message(glue::glue("  SOPs already calculated for imputation {imp_idx}, skipping..."))
    next
  }

  # Load model for this imputation
  model <- readRDS(here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "results", "models", glue::glue("model_imp_{imp_idx}.rds")))

  # Control arm
  if (generate_SOPS && !control_exists) {
    message(glue::glue("  Generating control SOPs for imputation {imp_idx}"))
    furrr::future_walk(
      1:nrow(baseline_df),
      \(x) write_SOP(x, 0, baseline_df, model, output_dir, imp_idx),
      .progress = TRUE,
      .options = furrr::furrr_options(
        seed = TRUE,
        packages = c("rmsb", "Hmisc", "data.table", "arrow", "glue")
      )
    )
  }

  # Treatment arm
  if (generate_SOPS && !treatment_exists) {
    message(glue::glue("  Generating treatment SOPs for imputation {imp_idx}"))
    furrr::future_walk(
      1:nrow(baseline_df),
      \(x) write_SOP(x, 1, baseline_df, model, output_dir, imp_idx),
      .progress = TRUE,
      .options = furrr::furrr_options(
        seed = TRUE,
        packages = c("rmsb", "Hmisc", "data.table", "arrow", "glue")
      )
    )
  }
}
```
